subject: Maintainer mentorship credit top-up request — ByteJam
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <maya@bytejam.dev>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: mentorship credits for ByteJam maintainers

Hi Grace,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from the ByteJam organizing team. We run a dedicated mentorship stream for open-source maintainers during our weekend hackathon (Feb 26–28). Historically maintainers volunteer their time; this year we’re trying to give them a small stipend and compute support so they can run live office hours and small pairing sessions.

Specifically: would Redwood consider a credits top-up we can allocate to ~12 maintainers (not a single team) — ideally a 6-week trial extension plus ~8k compute-credit equivalent per maintainer. We’d also love 2 mentor seats for the organizer team to triage issues during event hours.

I’ve attached our sponsorship packet for context (talking schedule, list of repos we expect to support, past mentor list). Timeline: we need confirmation by next Thurs (Jan 13) to include Redwood in our mentor comms and landing page.

If helpful, happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through use cases and expected redemption flow.

Thanks for considering — Maya

--
Maya Gupta
Community Lead, ByteJam Hackathon
maya@bytejam.dev
Attachment: bytejam_sponsorship_packet.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@bytejam.dev>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mentorship credits for ByteJam maintainers

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the packet. This is the sort of community program we love to support. I’m looping in Jordan (partnerships) and Aditya (promo budget) to confirm what we can allocate and the best redemption mechanics.

Couple quick questions to help speed approvals:
- Can you confirm the exact count of maintainers (you mentioned ~12 — is that final?) and whether they are individual GitHub accounts (we need usernames to issue credits).
- Do the mentors need isolated billing per maintainer or a single pool we can label for each maintainer?
- Are there any compliance/regulatory constraints (e.g., embargoed or private corp repos) we should be aware of?

Jordan/Aditya — if we can get an OK for a 6-week trial extension + ~8k compute-credit per maintainer (12 max) plus 2 mentor seats, I’ll confirm with Maya and get promo artifacts ready (redemption link/DocuSign if needed).

Grace O'Connor
Head of Developer Programs, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mentorship credits for ByteJam maintainers

+1 from me. This fits our community playbook. My suggested offer (to keep within promo budget and still be meaningful):
- 6-week trial extension for each approved maintainer account
- 8,000 compute-credits per maintainer (redeemable against hosted API or dedicated trial)
- 2 mentor seats for organizer accounts (full access for event hours only)
- Cap the program at 12 maintainers; if they need more we can evaluate after event metrics (engagement / signups).

Aditya — can you route this through Promo (SUP-2381) and confirm we’ve got budget headroom? I’ll draft the short redemption flow (one-time token per maintainer + team seats) and the T&Cs.

Jordan
Director, Partnerships
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@bytejam.dev>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mentorship credits for ByteJam maintainers

Hi Maya — good news: we can support ByteJam’s mentorship stream. Offer below — please confirm maintainer GitHub handles and which two organizer accounts should receive mentor seats. Once you confirm we'll send redemption tokens and the short DocuSign acceptance for the mentor-seat terms.

Offer (ByteJam Maintainer Mentorship Top-up):
- 6-week trial extension applied to each approved maintainer account (up to 12 maintainers)
- 8,000 compute-credits allocated per maintainer (redeemable on hosted Redwood API)
- 2 organizer mentor seats with full access during event hours
- Promo cap: total of 96,000 compute-credits (12 x 8k); overages must be pre-approved

Action items for you:
1) Reply with the list of maintainer GitHub handles and two organizer emails for mentor seats.
2) Sign the short redemption agreement here: https://na1.docusign.net/XYZ-ByteJam-Redemption (we’ll also attach the signed PDF to the redemption record).

We’ll route this under internal promo id PROMO-2027-017 / SUP-2381. Jordan/Aditya — I’ve included the final offer above; please escalate if any edits are needed before we send tokens.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Developer Programs | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachment: bytejam_sponsorship_packet.pdf
